lines.say: Should you throw away the egg yolk?
Many lifters eat only egg whites, because the yolk has fat and cholesterol.
But for most healthy people, eggs affect blood cholesterol less than people think. Your liver makes most of it anyway.
And in one study, lifters who ate whole eggs after training built more muscle protein than those who ate the same protein from whites.
The yolk also has vitamins A, D and B twelve, plus choline.
So keep the yolk. About one egg a day is fine for most healthy people.
If you have high cholesterol or diabetes, ask your doctor how many.
